solution_summary: PwC built its solution on Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search to automate high-friction work and turn enterprise data into faster decisions. The implementation combines cloud application services, data services, and AI capabilities so business users can search, summarize, analyze, or act on information through a single digital workflow instead of manual handoffs. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Microsoft Word, GitHub Copilot, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for model orchestration, experimentation, and responsible AI operations.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Search
solution_components.role: Indexes enterprise content and retrieves grounding context for assistants and search experiences.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Document Intelligence
solution_components.role: Extracts text, layout, and document fields before downstream AI or analytics processing.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Hosts scalable APIs, microservices, and model-serving workloads in containers.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in Azure AI Search, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
